translationRepairs: As a son of a great house, at the end of Song he was matched to a princess, made commandant of the horse for the imperial son-in-law and secretary gentleman, and rose through literary scholar to the prince of Guiyang, friend to the prince of Nankang, and secretary assistant.

As a son of a great house, at the end of Song he was matched to a princess, made commandant of the horse for the imperial son-in-law and secretary gentleman, and rose through literary scholar to the prince of Guiyang, friend to the prince of Nanjun, and secretary assistant.
Chinese 南郡王 is Prince of Nanjun; English Nankang would require 南康, so the replacement correctly restores the fief name.

Liang was a scion of a famous house; at the end of Song he was chosen to marry a princess, made Commandant of the Horse for the Imperial Son-in-law and Secretary Gentleman, and rose through Literary Scholar to the Prince of Guiyang, Friend to the Prince of Nankang, and Secretary Assistant.

Liang was a scion of a famous house; at the end of Song he was chosen to marry a princess, made Commandant of the Horse for the Imperial Son-in-law and Secretary Gentleman, and rose through Literary Scholar to the Prince of Guiyang, Friend to the Prince of Nanjun, and Secretary Assistant.
Chinese 南郡王 is Prince of Nanjun; English Nankang would require 南康, so the literal replacement correctly restores the fief name.
In summer of the fourth year Gaozu feasted at Hualin Hall and told the ministers, "From noon I hear government, wishing to learn gain and loss.
In summer of the fourth year Gaozu feasted at Huaguang Hall and told the ministers, "From noon I hear government, wishing to learn gain and loss.
Chinese 華光殿 is Huaguang Hall; Hualin would be 華林, so the replacement correctly names the hall.
In summer of the fourth year Gaozu feasted at Hualin Hall and said to the assembled ministers: "From noon I hear affairs of state, wishing to learn gain and loss.
In summer of the fourth year Gaozu feasted at Huaguang Hall and said to the assembled ministers: "From noon I hear affairs of state, wishing to learn gain and loss.
Chinese 華光殿 is Huaguang Hall; Hualin would be 華林, so the literal replacement correctly names the hall.

Left assistant director Fan Zhen rose and said, "Grand marshal Xie Tiao had only empty fame, yet Your Majesty raised him so; former director Wang Liang had real governing merit, yet Your Majesty cast him off so—this dull minister cannot understand."

Left assistant director Fan Zhen rose and said, "Grand Marshal Xie Fei had only empty fame, yet Your Majesty raised him so; former director Wang Liang had real governing merit, yet Your Majesty cast him off so—this dull minister cannot understand."
Chinese 謝朏 is Xie Fei; Xie Tiao is a different person (謝朓), so the replacement correctly restores the given name.

Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing Fan Zhen rose and said: "Grand Marshal Xie Tiao originally had only empty fame, yet Your Majesty raised him thus; former Director Wang Liang truly had governing merit, yet Your Majesty cast him off like that—this a dull minister cannot understand."

Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing Fan Zhen rose and said: "Grand Marshal Xie Fei originally had only empty fame, yet Your Majesty raised him thus; former Director Wang Liang truly had governing merit, yet Your Majesty cast him off like that—this a dull minister cannot understand."
Chinese 謝朏 is Xie Fei; Xie Tiao is a different person (謝朓), so the literal replacement correctly restores the given name.
His father Mao was Minister of the Imperial Stud and Marquis of Xiang of Nanxiang.
His father Mao was grand master of splendid happiness and Marquis Xi of Nanxiang.
Chinese 光祿大夫 is grand master of splendid happiness and 南鄉僖侯 is Marquis Xi of Nanxiang; Imperial Stud and Marquis of Xiang misread both titles.
His father Mao was Minister of the Imperial Stud and Marquis of Xiang of Nanxiang.

Chinese 光祿大夫 is Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and 南鄉僖侯 is Marquis Xi of Nanxiang; Imperial Stud and Marquis of Xiang misread both titles.
After three years in office he became attendant within and minister of the imperial clan, with concurrent left palace guard general.
After three years in office he became attendant within and grand master of splendid happiness, with concurrent left palace guard general.
Chinese 光祿大夫 is grand master of splendid happiness, not minister of the imperial clan, so the replacement correctly restores the office.
After three years in office he was transferred to Attendant Within and Minister of the Household for the Imperial Clan, with concurrent Left Palace Guard General.
After three years in office he was transferred to Attendant Within and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, with concurrent Left Palace Guard General.
